paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 scores (%) achieved by four variants of the MADLLM model across six different datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis lists the datasets in the specified order, while the vertical axis represents the F1 Score (%) on a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each dataset has four grouped bars, each corresponding to a different model variant: MADLLM (green), MADLLM without feature embedding (purple), MADLLM without prompt pool (blue), and MADLLM without skip embedding (orange). The green bars (MADLLM) consistently achieve the highest F1 scores across all datasets, with values ranging approximately from 75% (WADI) to 98% (PSM). The purple bars (without feature embedding) are generally the second highest, followed by the orange bars (without skip embedding), and the blue bars (without prompt pool) are typically the lowest. For example, on the SMD dataset, the F1 scores are approximately 94% (green), 91% (purple), 90% (blue), and 92% (orange). On the WADI dataset, the scores are approximately 75% (green), 62% (purple), 63% (blue), and 68% (orange). The bars are arranged in groups for each dataset, and the legend is located below the chart to identify the color-coded model variants. There is no explicit sorting of datasets by performance; they are presented in a fixed order. No bars are visually emphasized through additional shading or annotations.
